newsitem.title: USA: Above-normal temps predicted for parts of US - NWS.
newsitem.headline: Above-normal temps predicted for parts of US - NWS.

text.p: Above-normal temperatures are predicted for several regions in the United States in August, the National Weather Service said Thursday.
Above-normal temperatures are forecast for along the Eastern seabord from Florida to Delaware, over most of California, southern Texas and in southern and coastal portions of Alaska.

Below-normal temperatures, however, are expected in the Northwest and the Northeastern plateau region and in the area from the northern and central Rocky Mountains to the High Plains and north of Kansas, NWS said in its monthly report.
The outlook for precipitation next month is uncertain, NWS said. The next 30-day outlook will be issued on Thursday, August
